pubsub_topic.description: The Pub/Sub topic to send notifications to. Format: projects/[project_id]/topics/[topic].
pubsub_topic.rationale: Notifications are delivered to the specified Pub/Sub topic. Using an unapproved or insecure topic may expose findings to unauthorized subscribers.

streaming_config.rationale: The streaming filter defines which findings trigger notifications. Incorrect filters may miss critical issues or create excessive noise.

filter.description: Filter expression applied across asset or finding events. Must include valid conditions such as severity levels to ensure important findings are captured.
filter.rationale: A proper filter ensures that only relevant and high-severity findings are streamed. Missing or overly broad filters may reduce the effectiveness of alerts.

folder.description: Numerical ID of the parent folder where this notification config is defined.
folder.rationale: The folder scope determines where notifications apply but does not affect the security of the configuration itself.

config_id.description: Unique identifier for the notification config within the organization.
config_id.rationale: The config ID ensures uniqueness but does not directly impact security.

description.description: Optional description of the notification config (max 1024 characters).
description.rationale: Descriptions are for documentation purposes only and do not affect security.
description.compliant: Valid config with proper streaming filter
